title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1969-12-07
lineage: SBD > MC > DAT > CDR > EAC > DCart Millennium > CDR

ai_review.summary: Good soundboard capture of a heavy post‑Altamont show, highlighted by a smoking China Cat and an epic 28‑minute Turn On Your Lovelight.
ai_review.review: The performance is steeped in the melancholy of the night after Altamont, yet the band delivers several inspired moments – notably China Cat Sunflower, St. Stephen → The Eleven, and Pig Pen’s marathon Turn On Your Lovelight. The soundboard source is listenable but a bit muddy and hiss‑prone, requiring some EQ to fully enjoy.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews consistently praise the musical performance (many 4–5 star comments) while noting moderate recording flaws; weighted average yields a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Muddy and slightly hissy compared to ideal board recordings; listeners note the need for EQ but overall sound is clear enough to be enjoyable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A somber, post‑Altamont mood pervades the set, with early gloom giving way to brighter moments toward the end; the show feels like a historic snapshot rather than a high‑energy jam.
